Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Service provider must submit the following documents duly sealed and signed on each and every pages:- 1. An office of the service must be located in the state of consignee i..e Assam and service provide r have to upload/submit a valid/correct documents claiming the same. 5. Document should be legible and in correct order. If found not in correct order/illegible then offer will be rejected. 6. The contractor shall deposit, in advance, an amount equivalent to One (01) month's cumulative wages/s alary of the manpower proposed to be deployed under the contract with the office of Defence Estates Offic er, Tezpur, prior to finalization/award of the contract. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work and Terms & Conditions for Engageme nt of Contractual Manpower: Office Boy/Attendent Office:- O/o the Defence Estates Officer, Tezpur Cirlce. Purpose:- For Engagement of Contractual Office Boy/attendent for d ay to day Office related work pertaining to Defence Estates Officer, Tezpur Circle 1. Preamble In pursuance of the requirement for engagement of contractual manpower for rendering essential s upport services, this office proposes to procure such services through the Government e-Marketplace (Ge M) platform. The engagement shall be strictly on an outsourcing basis through a duly selected service pro vider. 2. Scope of Services The contractor shall provide requisite manpower for the following categories: Safai-Karmachari (Housekeeping & Sanitation) Peon / MTS / Office Boy (General Office Assistance) 2.1 Functional Responsibilities The deployed personnel shall, inter alia, perform the following duties: Day-to-day office assistance and routine administrative work Cleaning, upkeep, and sanitation of office premises Handling, movement, and dispatch of files and official correspondence

Any other work assigned by the controlling authority in the interest of official functioning 3. Deployment & Working Hours The normal duty shall be 05 (five) days per week, with 08 (eight) hours per day. Notwithstanding the above, in exigencies of service, the manpower may be required to work for 06 (six) days per week, without any additional remuneration or financial implication to this office. The deployed personnel shall strictly adhere to office timings and instructions issued by the compet ent authority from time to time. 4. Leave & Attendance Only 01 (one) day of leave per month shall be admissible. Leave in excess of the permissible limit shall entail proportionate deduction of wages, commen surate with attendance and duty performed. Absence without prior approval shall be treated as unauthorized absence, and shall be const rued as an act of indiscipline warranting appropriate action. 5. Discipline & Conduct The manpower deployed shall maintain absolute discipline, integrity, punctuality, and decoru m at all times. Any act of misconduct, negligence, or indiscipline shall render the individual liable for immediate re moval/replacement. Unauthorized absence, dereliction of duty, or insubordination shall be viewed seriously and dealt with accordingly. 6. Service Level Requirements (SLR) The contractor shall ensure the following minimum service standards: Continuous and uninterrupted deployment of manpower as per requirement Provision of suitable substitute within 24 hours in case of absence/non-performance Personnel shall be properly identified and, where required, uniformed Maintenance of efficiency, responsiveness, and service quality at all times 7. Penalty & Liquidated Damages Without prejudice to any other action available under the contract: Non-deployment or absenteeism without suitable replacement shall attract proportionate de duction of payment, along with penalty as deemed appropriate by the competent authority. Failure to provide replacement within 24 hours shall invite additional penalty. Persistent non-compliance or deficiency in service may lead to termination of contract. 8. Nature of Engagement

The engagement shall be purely contractual and co-terminus with the contract period. No right, whatsoever, for regularization or absorption shall accrue to the deployed personnel . The contract may be terminated by this office in case of unsatisfactory performance by giving 10 (t en) days’ notice, without assigning any further reason. 9. Statutory Compliance The contractor shall, notwithstanding anything contained herein, be solely responsible for: Compliance with all applicable Labour Laws, Rules, and Regulations, including those prescribed by the Assam Labour Commission Payment of minimum wages, EPF, ESI, and other statutory dues Maintenance of statutory records and registers Any liability arising out of non-compliance shall be borne exclusively by the contractor. 10. Payment Mechanism Payment shall be made to the contractor strictly as per GeM terms and subject to satisfactory perfo rmance. The contractor shall be exclusively responsible for disbursement of wages to the deployed manp ower in a timely manner. This office shall bear no liability, direct or indirect, with regard to wage payment or any statutor y dues of the deployed personnel. The contractor shall deposit, in advance, an amount equivalent to one (01) month’s cumulative wages/salary of the manpower proposed to be deployed under the contract with the office of Defence Estates Office, Tezpur, prior to finalization/award of the contract. 11.Evaluation of Bids Bids shall be evaluated as per GeM norms, ordinarily on L1 basis, subject to fulfillment of technic al as well as financial criteria. Non-compliance with any of the stipulated conditions shall render the bid liable for rejection. 12. Replacement of Personnel The contractor shall, upon direction of this office, replace any deployed personnel forthwith, wi thout demur. Replacement shall be ensured within 24 hours, failing which penalty provisions shall be invoked. 13. Indemnity Clause The contractor shall indemnify and keep indemnified this office against all claims, damages, losses, or legal liabilities arising out of: Non-compliance of statutory provisions Acts or omissions of the deployed personnel 14. Jurisdiction

All disputes arising out of or in connection with this contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the com petent court within the concerned State/UT. 15. Residuary Provision Any matter not specifically covered herein shall be governed by the applicable Government rules, instr uctions, and GeM provisions in force from time to time. This Scope of Work shall form the basis for engaging the Contractual Manpower: Office Boy/attend ent and may be modified as per administrative requirements of the Office of the Defence Estates Officer, T ezpur Circle. Place:- Tezpur Date:- 09/11/2026 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.
